You are given a list of pairs, where each pair represents a song and its artist:

"[song, artist]"

1. Choose the artist with the maximum number of remaining songs.
2. If multiple artists have the same maximum number of remaining songs, choose the artist whose next available song appears earliest in the original list.

Tredence analytics
1. Overall OA Pattern 1 question — 20 points 2 or 3 points each The Tredence OA consisted of 38 questions to be completed in 90 minutes: 36 MCQs, 1 DSA coding question, and 1 SQL question. There were many different question sets. The DSA and SQL questions varied substantially between sets. MCQs had comparatively less strict uniqueness, so some MCQs could overlap between different sets. The DSA question supported multiple programming languages. 2. MCQ Section — 36 Questions The MCQ section covered a broad range of topics: • Quantitative Aptitude • Probability & Statistics • Data Interpretation (DI) • Machine Learning (ML) • Pseudocode / Output-based questions • English / Grammar • Python: output-based and syntax-based questions Individual MCQs carried either 2 or 3 points. 3. DSA / Coding Section — 20 Points There was 1 DSA coding question. The problem could differ significantly between question sets. DSA Question — Set 1: Snack Selection A boy wants to eat snacks while maintaining a minimum required level of satisfaction and staying within a maximum allowed number of calories. Three arrays are given: • A[i] — satisfaction value of the i-th snack • B[i] — calories of the i-th snack • C[i] — cost of the i-th snack Given X as the minimum required satisfaction and Y as the maximum allowed calories, the task is to minimize the total cost of the snacks selected while satisfying both constraints.Constraints remembered: N is the input size of the arrays, with N between 1 and 100. The array values were within the constraints specified in the question. Approach used: 3-dimensional Dynamic Programming with index, satisfaction, and calories as the state parameters. The solution was accepted. DSA Question — Set 2: Second Largest Element to the Right Given an array, for every element find the second largest element among the elements to its right.
